body.x: SpeedFloor Inc., led by CEOs Austin Hong and Hyunjin Hong, will take part in CES 2027, which runs Jan. 6 to Jan. 9 (local time) in Las Vegas, as part of the Incheon Technopark pavilion, to introduce Moving Floor, an automated loading and unloading system for commercial vehicles.

The company was named a CES Innovation Awards Honoree in the Supply & Logistics category. Loading and unloading is a stretch of the logistics chain that still depends on manual labor, between automation inside warehouses and transport by vehicle. Moving Floor targets that gap with a belt built into the vehicle's cargo floor. An electric motor drives the belt through a chain and moves cargo from the interior of the vehicle toward the loading opening, so workers no longer have to enter the cargo area repeatedly and carry goods by hand. The company says this makes loading and unloading safer and more efficient.

The system's key advantage is that the cargo floor itself works as a conveyor. Whether it fits a given operation can be assessed from the vehicle's configuration, the type of cargo and the customer's workflow. SpeedFloor, founded in 2021, develops and sells the system and has deployed it in public-sector, manufacturing and logistics operations in Korea.

The technology has received Korea's Innovative Logistics Technology designation (No. 7) from the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport and has been selected for trial use by the Ministry of National Defense. SpeedFloor was also chosen for the robotics category of Korea's Super Gap Startup 1000+ Project, and its CES Innovation Awards Honoree selection is its most recent recognition.

Overseas, the company has built a supply chain in North America and exhibited at World Ag Expo in the United States, where it introduced how Moving Floor works and where it can be used. The United States and Europe are its main target markets. SpeedFloor wants to find sites where automated loading and unloading would improve the flow of goods between vehicles and logistics centers, and to develop supply plans that fit local vehicle configurations and operating conditions. It is looking for vehicle and trailer manufacturers, commercial vehicle upfitters, logistics automation providers, and local partners with sales, installation and maintenance capabilities, with the aim of building a support network that runs from assessing customer needs and system suitability to installation and after-sales service.

SpeedFloor plans to accelerate its entry into the U.S. market and widen the places where Moving Floor is used. It aims to build awareness in the United States and reach logistics and transport companies, vehicle manufacturers and upfitters that want to automate loading and unloading. The company will seek out customers who want to reduce repetitive cargo handling and then work out how Moving Floor can meet their operating needs. Coverage in U.S. trade media and exchanges with prospective customers and partners are meant to lead to sales opportunities and business partnerships.

AVING News, a global media company with 21 years of experience covering CES, operates AVING CES Newsroom (avingces.news), a dedicated platform for delivering the latest innovations to global audiences. Publishing more than 1,000 articles and conducting hundreds of on-site video interviews annually, AVING News has helped Korean startups gain international visibility and expand their global reach. At CES 2027, AVING News will operate the AVING TECH TALK broadcast zone at the Venetian Expo (Hall A, Booth 50271), providing on-site coverage and interviews that spotlight Korean companies and their latest innovations.

Ahead of CES 2027, AVING News will host the 3rd Innovation Awards Winners Networking Party at MIK BASE CAMP on Wednesday, November 25, at 5 p.m. The event will also feature individual video interviews with participating companies, with registration available through Eventus. In early December, AVING News will begin its pre-show coverage, including an interview program connecting Korean innovators with U.S. media outlets that regularly cover CES and participate in the Innovation Awards judging process.

After CES 2027 concludes, AVING News will co-host a post-show conference with participating companies to highlight their achievements, strengthen their domestic visibility and enhance their corporate reputation.
